edges.evidence: Transport reduces travel friction; timing is strategic, not a hard requirement.
Fossil Island contains birdhouse trapping.
Passive Hunter experience contributes to Hunter level.
Supply outputs may contribute but do not independently establish combat readiness.
Telekinetic Theatre actions award the corresponding Pizazz currency; exact rune use and throughput depend on execution.
Creature Graveyard actions award the corresponding Pizazz currency; exact rune use and throughput depend on execution.
Enchanting Chamber actions award the corresponding Pizazz currency; exact rune use and throughput depend on spell choice and execution.
Alchemist's Playground actions award the corresponding Pizazz currency; exact rune use and throughput depend on execution.
The Rune pouch purchase consumes 150 Telekinetic Pizazz points.
The Rune pouch purchase consumes 150 Graveyard Pizazz points.
The Rune pouch purchase consumes 1,500 Enchantment Pizazz points.
The Rune pouch purchase consumes 200 Alchemist Pizazz points.
The ordinary Rune pouch stores up to three rune types and supplies stored runes for casting.
Bones to Peaches consumes 200 Telekinetic Pizazz points.
Bones to Peaches consumes 200 Graveyard Pizazz points.
Bones to Peaches consumes 2,000 Enchantment Pizazz points.
Bones to Peaches consumes 300 Alchemist Pizazz points.
The deterministic shop purchase permanently unlocks the spell.
A Lumbridge & Draynor hard task requires casting Bones to Peaches in Al Kharid palace; the remaining diary tasks are separate external requirements.
The claimed elite diary removes the Dramen or Lunar staff equipment condition, while fairy-ring permission remains required.
The claimed hard diary makes the Ash sanctifier available from Tyss; it remains charge-dependent in use.
The claimed hard diary unlocks the Crafting Guild bank deposit box.
The claimed hard diary makes the Bonecrusher available from a ghost disciple; it remains charge-dependent in use.
As of the January 2026 change, the hard diary grants access to the Artio, Spindel, and Calvar'ion lairs.
A completed commission pays a fixed formula of twice its awarded Smithing XP, but net coins vary with supplied metal value, final quality, mistakes, and execution; no session output is implied.
Usable fairy rings provide the sourced BKQ access to the Enchanted Valley tree-spirit route.
Fossil Island access enables the underwater seaweed patches.
Pandemonium is the Sailing entry quest and grants Sailing skill access.
Sailing skill access enables Sailing activities; individual content retains its own requirements.
A skiff is purchased within the Sailing system after its entry quest; the 15,000-coin purchase cost remains an external resource requirement.
Skiff ownership requires at least 15 Sailing.
A realised one-handed stab weapon can affect combat capability; readiness remains account-specific.
Transport networks combine to reduce movement cost; neither is a hard requirement for the other.
Varlamore access is needed for the Hunters' Guild.
Each completed pyramid top has a fixed 10,000-coin sale value, while failures, desert supplies, and player throughput prevent any exact session total.
Valuable resale price is fixed at 55 coins each, or 65 after the stated Gladiator rank, but keys, house loot, and catch losses make total income variable.
Completing Troubled Tortugans grants Great Conch docking and Gryphon access.
Great Conch access requires at least 45 Sailing.
Port Roberts docking requires at least 50 Sailing.
Wyrmscraig docking requires at least 62 Sailing.
Wyrmscraig access permits starting Fallen From Grace; the quest retains its own skill requirements.
Completing Fallen From Grace unlocks Sunstone Golem Crafting.
Sunstone Golem Crafting has a one-in-300 Jeweller's Chisel reward chance.
Great Conch access includes the Shellbane Gryphon cave; repeat kills retain their Slayer-task gate.
Completing Troubled Tortugans is a hard prerequisite for ordinary Shellbane Gryphon access.
Ordinary repeat encounters require at least 51 Slayer.
Ordinary repeat encounters require an active Gryphons Slayer assignment; the separate elite-clue exception is not inferred from account state.
Shellbane Gryphon has a one-in-256 chance to drop Belle's Folly (tarnished).
The tarnished weapon is consumed by the deterministic repair.
Sleeping Giants unlocks the Giants' Foundry polishing wheel used for the repair.
Repairing Belle's Folly requires at least 70 Smithing.
The polishing-wheel repair deterministically consumes the tarnished weapon, produces Belle's Folly, and grants 500 Smithing XP.
Children of the Sun is a hard Perilous Moons quest prerequisite.
Twilight's Promise is a hard Perilous Moons quest prerequisite.
Starting Perilous Moons requires 48 Slayer, which cannot be boosted.
Starting Perilous Moons requires 20 Hunter, which cannot be boosted.
Starting Perilous Moons requires 20 Fishing, which cannot be boosted.
Starting Perilous Moons requires 20 Runecraft, which cannot be boosted.
Starting Perilous Moons requires 10 Construction, which cannot be boosted.
Quest completion unlocks repeatable Moons of Peril encounters and Lunar Chest eligibility.
The repeatable encounter is the activity represented by the account-specific Perilous Moons readiness goal; this edge does not assert that an unevaluated account is ready.
Bounty tasks provide Sailing experience and coins.
Vale Totems provides Vale Research Points and a random-reward acquisition path.
The Fletching Knife affects Vale Totems and other supported repeated Fletching actions.
All-style offensive bonuses can improve account combat capability; readiness remains account-specific.
Golden nuggets are random sack rewards after cleaned pay-dirt, at a 3.13% rate per pay-dirt.
The upper level is a guaranteed 100-golden-nugget purchase, subject to 57 Mining.
The super hopper is a guaranteed 50-golden-nugget purchase after the upper level is unlocked.
The pay-dirt sack upgrade is a guaranteed 200-golden-nugget purchase.
The Prospector kit is a guaranteed 180-golden-nugget purchase.
The coal bag is a guaranteed 100-golden-nugget purchase.
The gem bag is a guaranteed 100-golden-nugget purchase.
Motherlode Mine's upper level requires at least 57 Mining.
The super hopper requires the Motherlode Mine upper level.
Motherlode Mine's lower level requires at least 30 Mining.
A one-handed melee weapon with slash and crush capability can alter account combat readiness; exact timing is strategic.
The Restless Ghost is a direct Nature Spirit quest prerequisite.
Priest in Peril is a direct Nature Spirit quest prerequisite.
Nature Spirit is a direct Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest prerequisite.
Lost City is a direct Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest prerequisite.
Completing Fairytale I permits starting Fairytale II and reaching the Fairy Godfather permission checkpoint.
Lost City provides the Dramen-staff path, which fulfils the wielded staff condition; a Lunar staff is an alternative staff item.
Fairy-ring permission is required for usable transport but is not sufficient by itself.
With permission, a wielded Dramen or Lunar staff is required to use fairy rings unless the elite diary exception is complete.
Lumbridge & Draynor Elite Diary removes the staff-equipment requirement; fairy-ring permission remains required.
The Dig Site enables the Museum specimen-cleaning contribution toward the permanent Kudos counter.
The Dig Site is a direct Bone Voyage quest prerequisite.
Bone Voyage requires at least 100 Museum Kudos; Kudos are a permanent non-spendable counter and are not consumed.
Completing Bone Voyage grants permanent Fossil Island access via the Digsite barge.
Farming contracts can reward Hespori seeds.
Hespori has a one-in-35 Bottomless compost bucket drop.
Herb storage can reduce inventory friction in herb-gathering Hunter content; exact timing is strategic.
Piety improves general melee capability; Moons' unique mechanics still require individual readiness assessment.
The defender's melee bonuses can improve combat readiness without being a hard requirement.
Heroes' Quest is a direct Throne of Miscellania prerequisite.
The Fremennik Trials is a direct Throne of Miscellania prerequisite.
Throne of Miscellania unlocks Kingdom management and seeds its coffer with 10,000 coins.
Throne of Miscellania is the direct Royal Trouble prerequisite.
Royal Trouble expands Kingdom management to 15 workers, raises its coffer and daily wage caps, and adds labour categories.
Rune Mysteries is the prerequisite for the Enter the Abyss miniquest.
Completing Enter the Abyss is a hard Temple of the Eye prerequisite.
Temple of the Eye requires at least 10 Runecraft.
Completing Temple of the Eye permanently unlocks Guardians of the Rift access.
Guardians of the Rift requires at least 27 Runecraft.
Any pickaxe is required to participate in Guardians of the Rift.
Elemental energy awards elemental reward points at the end of a game.
Catalytic energy awards catalytic reward points at the end of a game.
Each Rewards Guardian search consumes one elemental point.
Each Rewards Guardian search consumes one catalytic point.
A Rewards Guardian search has a one-in-seven chance to award 14-16 abyssal pearls; pearls are not guaranteed per search.
The one-in-300 abyssal-needle search roll is a random alternative to buying one with accumulated pearls.
The one-in-700 abyssal-lantern search roll is a random alternative to buying one with accumulated pearls.
Each Raiments piece is a guaranteed Temple Supplies purchase once its abyssal-pearl cost is held.
The Ring of the elements is a guaranteed 400-abyssal-pearl Temple Supplies purchase.
The abyssal needle is a guaranteed 750-abyssal-pearl Temple Supplies purchase once the pearls are accumulated.
The abyssal lantern is a guaranteed 1,500-abyssal-pearl Temple Supplies purchase once the pearls are accumulated.
Creating a colossal pouch requires an abyssal needle.
Creating a colossal pouch requires at least 25 unboosted Runecraft.
Creating a colossal pouch requires at least 56 unboosted Crafting.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the small pouch.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the medium pouch.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the large pouch.
Creating a colossal pouch combines the giant pouch.
Tithe Farm points are earned deterministically from deposited plants.
Tithe Farm requires at least 34 Farming.
Auto-weed is a guaranteed 50-point Tithe Farm purchase.
Sleeping Giants requires at least 15 Smithing.
Completing Sleeping Giants permanently unlocks Giants' Foundry.
A Foundry commission requires metal inputs worth at least two bars plus a bucket or ice gloves for the moulded weapon.
Completed Giants' Foundry commissions award Foundry Reputation based on final sword quality.
The double ammo mould is a guaranteed 2,000-reputation shop purchase, with Dwarf Cannon also required.
Purchasing the double ammo mould also requires Dwarf Cannon completion.
Smiths' uniform pieces are guaranteed Foundry Reputation shop purchases.
The permanent Foundry mould library is a guaranteed reputation purchase.
Successful Tempoross encounters earn reward permits at their stated full point thresholds.
Tempoross requires at least 35 Fishing.
Each reward permit is consumed for one Tempoross reward-pool roll.
The Fish Barrel is a one-in-400 Tempoross reward-pool roll and is not guaranteed after any number of permits.
Agility Pyramid requires at least 30 Agility.
Desert heat protection or waterskins are needed outside settlements, with food needed while obstacle failures remain possible.
Children of the Sun completion is the stated Civitas illa Fortis access condition for wealthy citizens.
Stealing valuables requires at least 50 Thieving.
Silk stalls require at least 20 Thieving.
Each eligible unnoted silk sale is a fixed 60 coins after the theft cooldown and barter, but successful steals and sale timing are player- and risk-dependent.
The Feud must be progressed far enough to use blackjacks; this is a partial access milestone, not a completion claim.
Bearded bandits require at least 45 Thieving.
A successful knocked-out bearded-bandit pickpocket gives 40 coins, but knock-out failure and player execution make total coins variable.
The Feud must be progressed far enough to use blackjacks; this is a partial access milestone, not a completion claim.
Bandits require at least 55 Thieving.
A successful knocked-out bandit pickpocket gives 50 coins, but knock-out failure and player execution make total coins variable.
Pandemonium completion is the stated Sailing entry condition for bounty tasks.
Sailing bounty tasks require at least 30 Sailing.
Each accepted completed bounty task pays a fixed amount equal to that task's base Sailing XP, but accepted tasks differ and no universal GP-per-hour output is implied.
Pandemonium completion is the stated entry condition for Sailing salvaging.
Beginning shipwreck salvaging requires at least 15 Sailing.
Beginning shipwreck salvaging requires a salvaging hook on a raft or better boat.
Shipwreck salvage is variable item loot rather than a fixed coin payout; any conversion value depends on the loot and later handling, so no session output is implied.
Port Roberts access enables its non-depleting thieving stalls.
The lowest-tier vegetable stall at Port Roberts requires at least 2 Thieving.
At 20 Thieving, the silk-stall option becomes available; higher stall tiers retain their separate Thieving gates.
Stalls yield items, not fixed direct coins; selected stall, subsequent sale or alchemy, and guard arrests determine any coin value.
Skiff ownership has a fixed 15,000-coin purchase requirement in addition to its Sailing and Sailing-entry conditions.
Kingdom starts with a fixed 10,000-coin coffer seed; 500,000 or 750,000 coin floors support the stated maximum daily wage caps and are funding thresholds, not quest-access requirements.
Coffer funding supports Kingdom worker wages after Kingdom management is unlocked; it does not establish the quest unlock.
Coins cover the listed house purchase or relocation costs; Daddy's Home is a separate non-coin alternative for the initial Rimmington house.
Starting The Feud has a listed 501-coin consumable preparation; the graph does not infer that the quest is completed.
Barrows gloves have a fixed 130,000-coin purchase price after Recipe for Disaster completion; the quest completion remains a separate unmodeled condition.
Waterfall Quest requires six each of air, earth, and water runes; this is a supply condition and does not claim quest completion.
Ali Morrisane's rune-shop access requires The Feud progression, represented here without claiming completion.
Ali Morrisane's rune-shop access also requires the Rogue Trader rune section; prices and stock are not modeled as a fixed cash commitment.
An axe is needed to attempt the Enchanted Valley woodcutting action that can spawn a tree spirit; no Woodcutting level is required to trigger it.
A defeated tree spirit has a Wiki-listed 1/32 Rune axe chance per kill; it is an RNG route and does not guarantee an axe after 32 kills.
Perry's Chop-chop Shop is in the Woodcutting Guild, which requires 60 Woodcutting to enter and can be boosted according to the cited item page.
Perry's listed Rune axe shop price is 40,960 coins; stock is one with a one-minute restock.
Purchasing the stocked Rune axe is a deterministic shop acquisition once its access and coin requirements are met.
The Rune axe provides the rune Woodcutting axe tier.
Using a Rune axe for Woodcutting requires at least 41 Woodcutting.
Defender of Varrock has a non-boostable 55 Smithing starting requirement; its listed quest prerequisite chains remain separate.
Defender of Varrock has a non-boostable 52 Hunter starting requirement; its listed quest prerequisite chains remain separate.
Meeting the two non-boostable skill gates is only part of Defender of Varrock's requirement set; the listed quest prerequisite chains remain separate.
Defender of Varrock completion grants the post-quest Zemouregal's Base armoured-zombie route.
Before looking over the second balcony, the quest instance has the same armoured-zombie drop table; this is a distinct partial-quest access state.
Each eligible armoured-zombie kill has a Wiki-listed 1/800 Broken zombie axe chance; it is not guaranteed after 800 kills.
One Broken zombie axe is the deterministic anvil-repair input.
Repairing a Broken zombie axe at an anvil requires at least 70 Smithing.
An anvil repair deterministically turns one Broken zombie axe into a Zombie axe and grants 500 Smithing XP.
The Zombie axe provides one-handed slash and crush melee capability.
Equipping the Zombie axe requires at least 65 Attack.
Only partial Path of Glouphrie completion is sourced for warped-creature access; the exact stage boundary is intentionally not inferred.
Warped and mutated creatures require at least 56 Slayer to damage.
Each listed warped or mutated creature source has a Wiki-listed 1/320 Warped sceptre chance per eligible kill; no kill count guarantees the item.
The uncharged Warped sceptre enables its built-in powered-staff spell after it is charged with its stated runes.
Equipping the Warped sceptre requires at least 62 Magic.
Zamorak warriors have a sourced 1/50 Rune scimitar chance per eligible kill; it does not guarantee the item after 50 kills.
Fire giants have a Wiki-listed 1/128 Rune scimitar chance per eligible kill; location-specific access can add requirements and the rate is not a guarantee.
Smithing a Rune scimitar requires at least 90 Smithing.
Smithing a Rune scimitar consumes two runite bars.
Smithing with the stated level and two runite bars is the deterministic Rune scimitar acquisition path.
The Rune scimitar provides one-handed four-tick slash melee capability.
Equipping the Rune scimitar requires at least 40 Attack.
Warriors' Guild entry requires combined Attack and Strength of at least 130, or level 99 in either skill.
Cyclops-room entry requires at least 100 tokens and spends 10 on entry plus 10 per minute, unless the stated Attack-cape exemption applies.
Showing a Rune defender to Lorelai unlocks basement access; the defender need not remain in the bank afterward.
The basement milestone enables level-106 cyclopes, fought with melee, for the Dragon defender route.
Basement cyclopes have a Wiki-listed 1/100 Dragon defender chance per eligible kill, after the ordered top-floor defender chain and Kamfreena hand-ins; no nominal kill count guarantees it.
The Dragon defender provides offensive attack and strength bonuses in the shield slot.
Equipping the Dragon defender requires at least 60 Defence.
An unprotected Dragon defender surviving a death below level-20 Wilderness is unusable until repaired by Perdu.
Perdu's listed repair cost for the applicable unusable Dragon defender is a fixed 240,000 coins.
Perdu's paid repair deterministically restores the applicable unusable Dragon defender.
An established Fossil Island birdhouse loop enables later player-confirmed collection and reset cycles.
The normalized collection action requires an explicit ready observation; approximate elapsed time alone is not treated as readiness.
An established two-patch giant-seaweed loop enables later player-confirmed harvest and replant cycles.
The normalized harvest action requires an explicit ready observation; approximate elapsed time alone is not treated as readiness.
A player-observed eligible Tears of Guthix state enables a confirmed session; time and progress gates are not inferred.
The normalized session action requires explicit ready observation rather than calculating the seven-day and progress gates.
Managing Miscellania access enables player-confirmed resource collection.
The normalized Kingdom collection action requires an explicit ready observation and never calculates daily output or coffer deductions.
